themes.title: LLMs in Finance
themes.statement: Understanding, evaluating, and using language models as financial decision systems.
themes.description: We study LLMs not simply as text processors, but as systems that interpret evidence, form investment judgments, retrieve financial knowledge, and support decisions. Our work connects model behavior and evaluation directly to practical financial use.

subthemes.title: Understanding LLM behavior in investment analysis
subthemes.description: We examine the judgments LLMs produce, the investment biases they carry, and the ways apparently fluent transformations such as summarization can change the decision supported by the original evidence.

papers.title: Your AI, Not Your View: The Bias of LLMs in Investment Analysis
When Summaries Distort Decisions: Information Fidelity in LLM-Compressed Financial Analysis

subthemes.title: Evaluating LLMs for investment analysis
subthemes.description: Financial evaluation must measure more than answer accuracy. We build datasets and benchmarks for bias, retrieval, agentic research, factual grounding, and multilingual multimodal compliance.

papers.title: Evaluating LLMs in Finance Requires Explicit Bias Consideration
FinDER: Financial Dataset for Question Answering and Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation
FinAgentBench: A Benchmark Dataset for Agentic Retrieval in Financial Question Answering
MM-Compliance: A Multilingual Multimodal Dataset for Sustainability Compliance Auditing

subthemes.title: LLM-based investment strategies and financial advisors
subthemes.description: We translate language understanding into investment signals, risk controls, and personalized expertise, from analyst reports and corporate disclosures to prediction markets and fund-manager personas.

papers.title: LLMs Analyzing Analysts: Do BERT and GPT Extract More Value from Financial Analyst Reports?
LLM as a Risk Manager: LLM Semantic Filtering for Lead-Lag Trading in Prediction Markets
From Text to Alpha: Can LLMs Track Evolving Signals in Corporate Disclosures?
Fund2Persona: A Framework for Building and Refining Financial Advisor Personas from Fund Disclosure Data

themes.title: Investment Decision Making
themes.statement: Learning and optimization methods built around the quality of the final investment decision.
themes.description: Prediction is only an intermediate step in finance. We develop learning and optimization methods that account for portfolio objectives, uncertainty, constraints, transaction structure, and long planning horizons.

subthemes.title: Decision-focused learning
subthemes.description: Rather than treating every prediction error equally, decision-focused learning identifies which errors alter the optimal portfolio and trains models around their downstream consequences.

papers.title: Decision-Focused Learning via Tangent-Space Projection of Prediction Error
Return Prediction for Mean-Variance Portfolio Selection: How Decision-Focused Learning Shapes Forecasting Models
Estimating Covariance for Global Minimum Variance Portfolio: A Decision-Focused Learning Approach
Decision-focused Sparse Tangent Portfolio Optimization

subthemes.title: Portfolio optimization
subthemes.description: We study scalable portfolio and financial-planning problems under multiple stages, uncertain future states, sparse decisions, and distributional shifts.

papers.title: Personalized Goal-Based Investing via Multi-Stage Stochastic Goal Programming
Value Function Gradient Learning for Large-Scale Multistage Stochastic Programming Problems
Large-scale Financial Planning via a Partially Observable Stochastic Dual Dynamic Programming Framework
Deep Value Function Networks for Large-scale Multistage Stochastic Programs
Enhancing Mean-Variance Portfolio Optimization through GANs-Based Anomaly Detection

themes.title: Financial Asset Modeling
themes.statement: Representing assets and market dynamics across prices, text, order flow, and synthetic data.
themes.description: Financial assets are observed through heterogeneous and evolving signals. We build representations and predictive methods that combine temporal structure, semantic information, cross-asset relations, uncertainty, and tabular features.

subthemes.title: Stock modeling with time series and text
subthemes.description: We represent stocks through price dynamics, textual context, semantic similarity, and synthetic market behavior, with emphasis on the information preserved for downstream investment tasks.

papers.title: FinTexTS: Financial Text-Paired Time-Series Dataset via Semantic-Based and Multi-Level Pairing
THEME: Enhancing Thematic Investing with Semantic Stock Representations and Temporal Dynamics

A Uniformly Distributed Random Portfolio

subthemes.title: Time-series forecasting
subthemes.description: We design targets, uncertainty estimates, and cross-asset representations that better reflect the asymmetric risks and changing regimes of financial forecasting.

papers.title: Retrieval-Corrected Conformal Prediction for Time Series
Stop-Loss Adjusted Labels for Machine Learning-Based Trading of Risky Assets
From Constituents to Index: Interpretable Price Movement Prediction via Cross-Asset Order Flow

subthemes.title: Tabular data modeling
subthemes.description: We study synthetic sequential tables and mixed-variable learning, where temporal fidelity, heterogeneous feature geometry, and limited labels are central challenges.

papers.title: Seq2Synth: Benchmarking Temporal Fidelity in Synthetic Sequential Tabular Data
Geodesic Flow Kernels for Semi-Supervised Learning on Mixed-Variable Tabular Dataset

themes.title: Investor Modeling & Personalization
themes.statement: Understanding heterogeneous investors and adapting decisions to their goals, behavior, and circumstances.
themes.description: There is no representative investor. We model heterogeneity in household finances and trading behavior, then translate it into personalized portfolios, recommendations, and other high-stakes decisions.

subthemes.title: Individual investor and household analysis
subthemes.description: We identify distinct financial conditions and behavioral patterns at the household and account level instead of reducing them to population averages.

papers.title: Identifying Household Finance Heterogeneity via Deep Clustering
Household Financial Health: A Machine Learning Approach for Data-Driven Diagnosis and Prescription

subthemes.title: Personalized investment decision making
subthemes.description: We connect user-specific objectives and preferences to optimization and recommendation methods that preserve diversification and decision relevance.
